title: test(rest): the registrar-file list's length is pinned as `toHaveLength(18)` in seven test files — drop the seven length pins, the list is the authority
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:server` (packages/rest tests) and the dogfood owner for the one copy in `packages/qa/dogfood`.

**Measured** (`origin/main` `e677770a`): `packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts:30` exports `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` (18 names) and its header says *"⛔ Not a gate: nothing runs this list on its own, and a reader that imports it stays the authority"*. Seven readers nonetheless pin the list's length to the literal 18: `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts:403`, `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts:1180`, `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts:428`, `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts:358`, `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts:288` (also pins `SITES` 8), `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts:298`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.test.ts:1642`. Moving one route module out of `rest-server.ts` reds all seven.

**Wanted:** delete the seven `toHaveLength(18)` assertions (and the `SITES` 8 pin) — each file keeps iterating the list it imports; where a test needs an anti-vacuity guard, `expect(list.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`. No other change. **Acceptance:** `git grep -n "REGISTRAR_FILES).toHaveLength"` → 0; the seven files pass. **Size:** XS. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
